recommendations.recommendation: Pursue justice in your soul, letting each part of it perform its proper role under reason.
recommendations.rationale: A just soul is harmonious, and only justice makes a person truly happy.
recommendations.argued_against: Letting appetite or spirit rule over reason.

recommendations.recommendation: Seek knowledge of the good and make philosophy the highest pursuit.
recommendations.rationale: Knowledge of the good orients the whole of life toward what is truly valuable.
recommendations.conditions: Applies most fully to those with the capacity for philosophy.
recommendations.argued_against: Valuing appearances and opinion over knowledge.

recommendations.recommendation: Educate the young first in music and gymnastics, then in mathematics and dialectic.
recommendations.rationale: Proper education forms character and prepares the mind for truth.
recommendations.scope: those responsible for educating the young

recommendations.recommendation: Live with moderation and avoid luxury.
recommendations.rationale: Luxury breeds appetites that corrupt both the individual and the city.
recommendations.argued_against: Luxury and the endless pursuit of wealth.

recommendations.recommendation: Avoid imitative and deceptive stories and poetry that corrupt the young.
recommendations.rationale: Stories shape character, so harmful ones must be excluded.
recommendations.scope: those who shape the education of the young
recommendations.argued_against: Imitative art that presents vice as admirable.

recommendations.recommendation: Do not treat wealth as the highest good; prefer justice to gain.
recommendations.rationale: The just person is happier than the unjust, even when the unjust person is rich.
recommendations.argued_against: Pursuing wealth at the expense of justice.

recommendations.recommendation: Be honest and just in all dealings, since the just life is the happiest.
recommendations.rationale: Justice is intrinsically good and brings the greatest inner happiness.
